rows.note: Use 碼 as the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the unit of length.

example.english: This rope is a yard long.
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sing4 jau5 jat1 maa5 coeng4

rows.note: Use 場地 for a designated outdoor work area or yard rather than a residential courtyard.

example.english: The timber needs to be kept in the yard.
example.traditional: 呢批木材要放喺場地度。
example.jyutping: ni1 pai1 muk6 coi4 jiu3 fong3 hai2 coeng4 dei6 dou6

rows.note: Use 天井 for an open courtyard or lightwell within or adjoining a house.

example.english: This old house has a yard, so it gets quite bright inside.
example.traditional: 呢間舊屋有個天井，入面幾光猛。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gau6 uk1 jau5 go3 tin1 zeng2 jap6 min6 gei2 gwong1 maang5

rows.note: Use 後院 when the house yard is specifically at the back of the house.

example.english: We’re having a barbecue in the yard behind the house.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 hau6 jyun2 sik6 siu1 haau1
